none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a C³ function f:E→ℝ, permitting nonconvex objectives. The initial objective gap satisfies f(x₀)−inf f≤Δ, and ‖∇f(x₀)‖≤G₀. No convexity or gradient-dominance condition is imposed.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Oracle 0 returns the full exact gradient ∇f(x) at any queried point, independently of the call index and seed. Gradient calls have a separate fixed budget.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GradientDependentHessian.lean: spec.admissible, oracle-0 equality; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Oracle 1 returns the full exact Hessian D(∇f)(x) as a continuous linear operator, independently of the call index and seed. Hessian calls have a separate fixed budget. Function values are not supplied by either oracle.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GradientDependentHessian.lean: spec.numOracles, spec.Reply, and spec.admissible, oracle-1 equality; LongTails/Template.lean: execute.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The pointwise third-derivative bound ‖D²(∇f)(x)‖≤L₀+L₁‖∇f(x)‖ holds globally, with L₀>0 and L₁≥0. This controls variation of the Hessian; it is not a bound on the Hessian norm itself.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, with its induced norm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters are public: E, x₀, L₀, L₁, Δ, G₀, ε, and m. Their restrictions are L₀>0, L₁≥0, Δ>0, G₀≥0, ε>0, and integer m≥1. The objective f is the hidden instance. The parameter m affects the supplied oracle budgets but imposes no additional condition on f.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GradientDependentHessian.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.Instance, spec.valid, and spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: Return a point x∈E satisfying ‖∇f(x)‖≤ε. The criterion uses the norm, not its square, and requires neither objective accuracy nor second-order stationarity.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The output criterion must hold almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law, within the separate fixed oracle budgets. Deterministic algorithm behavior is not required.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GradientDependentHessian.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm.law, Oracle.law, execute, and Convergence.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup uses gradient-dependent control of the third derivative instead of uniform Hessian Lipschitz continuity, with separately budgeted exact gradient and full-Hessian access.
